title: mentha sylvestris var. crispa
intro: Mentha sylvestris var. crispa, commonly known as curled mint, is a perennial herb belonging to the mint family (Lamiaceae). It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, soothing digestive issues, and alleviating respiratory problems due to its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of curled mint are attributed to its ability to calm the nervous system, relieve stress, and promote relaxation, which is thought to be a result of its bioactive constituents, including menthone, menthol, and limonene. The bioactive constituents of curled mint have been shown to exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities, contributing to its medicinal properties.
